comment: License policy for the merged release SBOM (license-policy.sh). Allowed everywhere = deny.toml [licenses] allow (read from deny.toml, not copied) + extra_allow. Anything else passes ONLY for the components an exception's match prefixes name (prefix of purl or bom-ref, or root = metadata.component), and every exception carries its reason. Add entries deliberately; the gate fails the release on anything not covered.

exceptions.reason: opensidian itself (the release root and its app crate) is GPL-3.0-or-later; same exception as deny.toml { crate = "opensidian" }, dependencies do not get it

elkjs (inlined into ui/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js since mermaid 12) is dual-licensed EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later; we take it under GPL-3.0-or-later, the license of the app itself; its EPL-2.0 text ships in ui/vendor/mermaid/LICENSES-bundled.txt

the Flathub GNOME runtime is not shipped in our artifacts: the flatpak installs it from Flathub; it aggregates many projects whose per-package licenses are in the runtime vendor SBOM (see the component's opensidian:license-note)
Ubuntu package whose /usr/share/doc/<pkg>/copyright is not DEP-5 machine-readable; the shipped copyright file is named in the component's opensidian:license-note and is reviewed by hand
